publications.title: Make the thinking visible
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Owner-approved Outspoken value proposition and proposed delivery process; editorial viewpoint.
publications.limitations: Proposed first-person voice and service workflow require founder review; no customer result is asserted.

publications.title: What our research can and cannot tell us
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Selected historical Outspoken sample: 279 posts/61 accounts; 107.5 median reactions among 276 observed; 36.5 median comments among 256 observed; captures 20–22 Oct 2026.
publications.limitations: Selected and differently aged posts, different metric denominators, no reach/conversions, no causality or current-trend claim.

publications.title: The sentence hiding inside a decision
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Owner-approved founder-led positioning and proposed interview-to-draft workflow.
publications.limitations: Interview described as proposed method, not a documented customer engagement or verbatim founder story.

publications.title: If everyone can say it
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Editorial positioning method grounded in the approved Outspoken value proposition; generic example is illustrative.
publications.limitations: No named competitor, customer outcome or validated conversion improvement is asserted.

publications.title: A bold claim needs a boundary
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Proposed evidence-led editorial process; example workflow is explicitly hypothetical.
publications.limitations: No performance number or product implementation asserted. Founder and factual review required.

publications.title: Turn a feature into a decision
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Editorial recommendation and hypothetical workflow example.
publications.limitations: No named product or verified feature claimed; founder must check any real substituted workflow.

publications.title: One story, two useful voices
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Editorial hypothesis derived from Outspoken's proposed founder/company content service.
publications.limitations: No causal or comparative channel-performance claim; proposed workflow requires review.

publications.title: A useful visual answers a question
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Editorial guidance from approved Outspoken service and design-system contract.
publications.limitations: Five seconds is a framing question, not a measured viewing-time claim. Illustrative people are not clients.

publications.title: A reaction is not a sale
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Historical selected reference sample: 279 posts; reaction counts observed on 276, comments on 256; captured 20–22 Oct 2026.
publications.limitations: No impression, reach, click or conversion evidence from this sample; proposed client practice, not delivered-client result.

publications.title: Your expertise stays yours
publications.caption: caption.txt
publications.evidence: Owner-approved value proposition and proposed Outspoken service workflow; approved CTA preserved exactly.
publications.limitations: Proposed service process and first-person voice require founder and delivery-capability review; no client outcomes claimed.
